data.title: Bitcoin ETFs log $228M in weekly sales as monthly outflows near $618M
data.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs had a rough October stretch. Investors pulled $228.6 million from the funds over the five trading days ending October 16, 2026.That brings month-to-date net outflows to roughly $615 million, with some tallies putting the figure closer to $618 million.These funds have become the…
